summary: Synth-pop: 110–130 BPM 80s pop on synths and drum machines, bright pads, FM bass and brass, catchy leads
body: Drums: drum machine pop beat, claps and snares with big reverb.
Harmony: major-key pop progressions with a bVII or II for color (I–IV–V–bVII).
Sounds: DX7 FM bass and brass, bright pads, bells; a simple, singable lead.

Apply: pattern/gmd-pop-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-synth-pop-characteristic-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 110–130 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
